title: Deployment
what: Placing and starting services in the right environment.
why: To ensure each workload lands on suitable infrastructure with access to resources.
when: When launching a new VNF or service chain.
example: A vFirewall is instantiated near the east-west traffic boundary.
scenarioApplication: Scaling a service or adding security enforcement.

title: Scaling
why: To maintain service quality under usage changes.
when: When traffic, users, or workloads increase or decrease.
example: A vLoadBalancer instance adds capacity during peak traffic.
scenarioApplication: User growth, service spikes, or failover events.

title: Migration
what: Moving a VNF or service to another resource location.
why: To restore service health or optimize utilization.
when: When a node fails or a resource becomes overloaded.
example: A security function moves to a healthy compute node.
scenarioApplication: Failures, maintenance windows, or balancing workloads.
